title: Keys and integrations
subtitle: Bots, personal keys and webhooks of the organization — who created them, for what, and when they were last used

noAccess.title: Only the owner and admins see this section
noAccess.body: Keys give programmatic access to the organization’s data, so they are managed by the roles that answer for it.

status.expiringIn: Expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

frozenReason.creator_left: The person who created the bot left the organization — the owner decides what happens next
frozenReason.owner: Frozen by the owner or an admin

stepUp.title: Confirm key management
stepUp.body: Keys give access to data without a password. Confirm with your password and an SMS code — the window stays open for 15 minutes.
stepUp.confirmTitle: Enter the code from the SMS

reveal.title: Save the key now
reveal.note: The key is shown only once. It is not stored anywhere — if you lose it, issue a new one by rotating.
reveal.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the key and copy it manually
reveal.savedCheck: I saved the key in a safe place

scope.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No services selected} one {# service selected} other {# services selected}}

key.name: Name
key.purposeHint: Required — in six months the registry has to explain why this key exists
key.purposePlaceholder: Sync tasks with the warehouse system
key.scopesHint: Only the services the integration really needs; write includes read
key.expiryMax: Organization policy allows at most {days} days
key.noExpiryHint: Only with an IP allowlist. Prefer a term with rotation.
key.allowlistHint: Optional. Addresses or CIDR ranges, one per line. Requests from other addresses are rejected and reported.
key.storedHintHint: A note for yourself: vault, server, CI variable — helps during rotation
key.graceLabel: Keep the old key working for
key.rotateNote: A new key is issued; the old one keeps working during the overlap so the integration can switch without downtime.
key.rotatedNote: Replace the old key in the integration before the overlap ends. The new key is shown only once.
key.revokeNote: Requests with this key stop immediately. This cannot be undone — issue a new key if needed.

personal.title: Keys and apps
personal.subtitle: Personal keys for your own data: scripts, automations, your own apps. A key works only for you and cannot be used with an organization.
personal.orgNote: The key acts as you inside this organization with the chosen access. It is revoked when you leave the organization or lose the admin role.
personal.ownNote: The key acts as you for your personal data only.

empty.title: No personal keys yet
empty.body: Create a key for a script or an app that works with your data.

personal.deadCount: {count, plural, one {# revoked or expired key} other {# revoked or expired keys}}

bot.intro: A bot is a separate identity of the organization: it works in tasks, calendar and documents as an employee, limited by its access. It belongs to the organization, not to the person who created it.

empty.title: No bots yet
empty.body: Create a bot for an integration: a warehouse system, a CRM, an automation.

bot.name: Name
bot.purposeHint: Required — who will remember in a year what this bot does
bot.rankHint: Decides what the bot sees, like an employee of that rank
bot.responsibleHint: Optional. Who answers for the bot — otherwise the owner and admins
bot.scopesHint: Services open to bots; people-only services (messenger, finance) are unavailable
bot.scopesEditHint: Changes apply to all live keys of the bot at once
bot.createdNote: This is the bot key. It is shown only once — save it in the integration now.
bot.liveKeys: {count, plural, =0 {no live keys} one {# live key} other {# live keys}}
bot.allowlistCount: {count, plural, one {# IP rule} other {# IP rules}}
bot.newKeyNote: A second key for another environment or a smooth migration. Access is the same as the bot’s.

freezeConfirm.title: Freeze bot «{name}»?
freezeConfirm.message: Its keys stop working immediately. Nothing is deleted — the bot can be unfrozen by the owner.

archiveConfirm.title: Archive bot «{name}»?
archiveConfirm.message: All its keys are revoked and its role is removed. The history stays. This cannot be undone.

empty.title: The registry is empty
empty.body: Bots, personal keys for organization data and webhooks will appear here.

registry.pending: {count, plural, one {# bot is waiting for the owner’s decision} other {# bots are waiting for the owner’s decision}}

empty.title: The journal is empty
empty.body: Every action with keys, bots and webhooks is recorded here and cannot be edited.

policy.title: Key policy
policy.body: Ceilings for key lifetimes and the IP allowlist requirement. Applies to new keys.
policy.ownerOnly: Only the owner changes the policy
policy.maxPatDays: Personal keys for organization data, max days
policy.noCeiling: No ceiling — the owner may issue bot keys without an expiry date (with an IP allowlist)
policy.noCeilingHint: Prefer a term with rotation: a key without an expiry date is a permanent session.
policy.requireIpAllowlist: Require an IP allowlist for every key
policy.requireIpAllowlistHint: Keys without an allowlist cannot be created

webhook.intro: Webhooks deliver events of the organization to your systems: a signed HTTPS request per event, retries with backoff, an endpoint is disabled after a series of failures.

empty.title: No webhooks yet
empty.body: Add an HTTPS address and choose the events it should receive.

webhook.urlNote: Only public HTTPS addresses. After creation a verification ping is sent — the endpoint must answer 2xx.
webhook.signingHint: Standard Webhooks: headers webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature
webhook.signingHmacHint: Verify with the secret shown once
webhook.signingEd25519Hint: Verify with the public key; no shared secret
webhook.createdNote: This is the signing secret. It is shown only once — put it into the receiver now.

rotateConfirm.title: Rotate the signing secret?
rotateConfirm.message: A new secret is issued; the old one stays valid for {hours} hours so the receiver can switch.

webhook.rotatedNote: The old secret keeps working for {hours} hours. The new one is shown only once.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete the webhook?
deleteConfirm.message: Deliveries stop immediately. The history stays in the journal.

webhook.failures: {count, plural, one {# failure in a row} other {# failures in a row}}
webhook.pendingHint: Waiting for the verification ping to be answered with 2xx

disabledReason.failures: Disabled after a series of failed deliveries
disabledReason.verification: The verification ping was not answered
disabledReason.signature_audit: Disabled: the endpoint accepted a request with an invalid signature (signatures are not verified)

throttledReason.export: the daily limit of exported rows is reached
